description: Create a new affiliate campaign with its reward rule. For reward_type percent pass commission_percent; for amount pass commission_amount_cents and commission_amount_currency. Rewardful: POST /v1/campaigns.

commission_amount_cents.description: Fixed commission in cents. Required when reward_type is amount.

commission_amount_currency.description: ISO currency code of the fixed commission, e.g. USD. Required when reward_type is amount.

commission_percent.description: Commission percentage. Required when reward_type is percent.

minimum_payout_cents.description: Minimum cumulative commissions before a payout, in cents of the company's display currency.

private.description: true = invite-only; false = anyone can sign up.

reward_type.description: Percent of each sale, or a fixed amount.

stripe_coupon_id.description: Stripe coupon for double-sided incentives. Growth/Enterprise plans only.

url.description: Base URL used to build affiliate links, e.g. https://example.com.

name: rewardful_create_campaign
title: Create a campaign
